records.applicationTiming: 3 splits: vegetation start (EC 21-25), stem elongation (EC 31-32), late quality N (EC 39-51).
records.applicationMethod: Strictly capped by Düngebedarfsermittlung (German Fertilizer Ordinance DüV). 3 splits: start of vegetation (EC 21-25), stem elongation (EC 31-32), and late quality N (EC 39-51). High-protein A-B Weizen, 8-9 t/ha target.

records.applicationTiming: 2 splits: spring green-up (50-60%) and stem elongation (40-50%).
records.applicationMethod: 2 splits: spring green-up (50-60% of N) and stem elongation (40-50%). Winter barley.

records.applicationTiming: 2 splits: early spring start and shooting stage (EC 31).
records.applicationMethod: 2 splits: early spring start and shooting stage (EC 31). Hybrid winter rye (Winterroggen).

records.applicationTiming: Under-root starter band at sowing; top-dress before row closure.
records.applicationMethod: Organic manure incorporated + under-root starter band (NP 20/20) at sowing; top-dress before row closure. Silomais/Körnermais.

records.applicationTiming: Applied at spring drilling or split with early shooting.
records.applicationMethod: Applied at spring drilling or split with early shooting (Hafer).

records.applicationTiming: 2 splits in spring: vegetation start and EC 31-32.
records.applicationMethod: 2 splits in spring: vegetation start and stem elongation (EC 31-32).

records.applicationTiming: Fall N max 30-60 kg/ha (DüV); spring split 60% rosette restart, 40% green bud.
records.applicationMethod: Fall N limited to max 30-60 kg/ha under DüV. Spring split: 60% at rosette restart, 40% at green bud stage. Winter rapeseed (Winterraps).
records.source_org: UFOP (Union zur Förderung von Oel- und Proteinpflanzen)

records.applicationTiming: Applied pre-drilling or banded at seeding.
records.applicationMethod: Applied pre-drilling or banded at seeding.

records.applicationTiming: P/K in autumn/early spring; N incorporated immediately before sowing.
records.applicationMethod: P/K applied in autumn/early spring; N incorporated immediately before sowing. Higher N reduces technical sugar yield (Zuckerrübe).

records.applicationTiming: Full P/K + 60% N at planting beds; 40% N at ridging.
records.applicationMethod: Full P/K + 60% N placed into planting beds; remainder at ridging. Speise- & Stärkekartoffeln.

records.applicationTiming: Applied pre-sowing and incorporated; inoculation required.
records.applicationMethod: No N needed (biological N-fixation). Applied pre-sowing and incorporated; inoculation with Bradyrhizobium japonicum required.
